mapper.select: SELECT r.user_id, u.real_name as user_name, o.org_name, r.read_flag, r.read_time FROM sys_message_receiver r LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON r.user_id = u.id AND u.del_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user_org so on so.user_id = u.id and so.is_main = '1' LEFT JOIN sys_org o ON so.org_id = o.id AND o.tenant_id = so.tenant_id AND o.del_flag = 0 WHERE r.message_id = #{messageId}
SELECT m.type FROM sys_message_receiver r INNER JOIN sys_message m ON r.message_id = m.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.read_flag = 0 AND m.send_channel = 'WEB'
